title: ThroughLine Release Stamp

version.description: Stable release semver. Native build counter = major*1000000 + minor*1000 + patch; minor and patch0..999, counter1..2100000000. iOS buildNumber = decimal string(counter); Android versionCode = counter. Same release always produces the same counter; increasing stable releases are monotonic within these bounds.

commit.description: Ship tool verifies main-line ancestry; reader validates format only.

upstream_base_commit.description: Required pinned upstream identity from tax_policy.pinned_upstream. The ship tool verifies merge-base agreement at cut and binds this value beside stamp_sha256 in the run ledger. The reader validates format only; it neither computes a merge-base nor decides readiness.

stamped_by.description: Committed source uses development:<identity> and cannot supply a release identity. Release consumers require throughline-ship@<semver>; this is label classification only, not proof of stage-time ledger custody or readiness.

$comment: Every platform occurs exactly once across platforms and deferred. Reader also enforces valid UTC calendar timestamp, nonzero commit/version, counter bounds and caller purpose. The source stamp is development-only. Throughline-ship writes the release stamp only in the staged tree and records its bytes in the run ledger. This schema does not decide readiness, installation, or authority.
